name: ELSA
recent: ELSA 近期出现多项公司秘书变动，一名董事在闭门期外增持股份，并有一名大股东权益变动。公司发布 2026 财年上半年业绩，新闻提及正常化净利 280 万令吉，但受上市后一次性因素影响。
notable: 公司秘书 NURUL SYAHIDAH BINTI MAT TAHIL 及 THIEN LEE MEE 发生变动。
董事 MR DANIEL ILHAM KHONG 于 2026 年 10 月 1 日以每股 0.230 令吉增持 500 万股。
大股东 MR DANIEL ILHAM KHONG 的权益发生变动。
risks: 董事及大股东在闭门期内有交易意向的申报，以及闭门期外的实际交易。

events.what_en: Director acquires 5M shares at RM0.230 each

recent_en: ELSA recently saw changes in company secretaries, an acquisition of shares by a director outside the closed period, and a change in a substantial shareholder's interest. The company released its 1H FY2026 results, with news citing normalised net earnings of RM2.8 million, impacted by one-off post-IPO items.
notable_en: Changes in company secretaries involving NURUL SYAHIDAH BINTI MAT TAHIL and THIEN LEE MEE.
Director MR DANIEL ILHAM KHONG acquired 5,000,000 shares at RM0.230 per share on 1 October 2026.
Change in substantial shareholder's interest of MR DANIEL ILHAM KHONG.
risks_en: Notification of intention to deal during closed period and actual dealings outside closed period by directors and a substantial shareholder.
